# Workspace Isolation & Resource Quotas Checklist: Workspace Foundation

**Purpose**: Reviewer-owned requirements-quality validation ("Unit Tests for English") covering notebook lifecycle (`FR-WM-01`), cross-notebook and cross-owner context isolation (`FR-WM-04`, `C-01`, `C-02`, `NFR-EVAL-04`), and atomic baseline resource quotas (`FR-WM-07`, `NFR-SEC-01`).
**Created**: 2026-10-17
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) | [plan.md](../plan.md) | [data-model.md](../data-model.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are all four notebook lifecycle operations (create, open, rename, permanent delete) specified with explicit trigger events, expected persisted state changes, and UI transitions? [Completeness, Spec §R01 — FR-WM-01]
- [ ] CHK002 Are the cascade deletion requirements complete across relational entities (`sources`, `chunks`, `chat_threads`, `chat_messages`), raw/derived Cloud Storage object generations, and in-flight background jobs? [Completeness, Spec §R01 — FR-WM-01, Plan §Design Sequence and Integration Boundaries]
- [ ] CHK003 Does the specification define the exact request provenance fields (`notebook_id`, explicit `active_source_ids`, `(source_id, revision)` pairs, and effective authorization) required on every `ScopedContextProvider` (`C-02`) call? [Completeness, Spec §R02 — FR-WM-04, Spec §Cross-package requirements CP-01/CP-02]
- [ ] CHK004 Are all four baseline quota dimensions (notebooks per user, sources per notebook $N_{\text{max}}$, bytes per upload, extracted words per source) specified with both their default values and configurable bounds? [Completeness, Spec §R03 — FR-WM-07]

## Requirement Clarity & Precision

- [ ] CHK005 Is the notebook title length constraint unambiguously defined in terms of Unicode code points after outer whitespace trimming (`1` to `100` code points inclusive) rather than UTF-8 byte length or grapheme clusters? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the distinction between the `200 MB` file size limit ($200,000,000\text{ bytes}$ inclusive) and the $500,000$ extracted-word limit stated clearly as two independent, inclusive thresholds? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §R03 — FR-WM-07]
- [ ] CHK007 Does the specification clearly distinguish between the UI's initial checkbox state ("All Ready sources" selected in the client session) and the server-side prohibition against omitting `active_source_ids` or falling back to all sources? [Clarity, Spec §Cross-package acceptance scenarios #1, Spec §Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK008 Are the source lifecycle states that consume a notebook quota slot (`Uploading`, `Processing`, `Ready`) explicitly distinguished from states that release the slot (`Failed` and dismissed error rows)? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §Clarifications]

## Requirement Consistency & Contract Alignment

- [ ] CHK009 Do the `Contract C-01` locator definitions in the specification and plan consistently restrict the union to `page_span | time_span | dom_path` without introducing `char_span` or `slide_number` as separate variants? [Consistency, Spec §Source Traceability & Package Scope, Plan §Constitution Check CC-05]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the v1.0 role model consistently restricted to `Owner`-only access across `spec.md`, `plan.md`, and `contracts/workspace-api.md`, while keeping `Editor` / `Viewer` / `Chat-only` deferred to `v6.0` (`FR-WM-05`)? [Consistency, Spec §Source Traceability & Package Scope, Plan §Technical Context]
- [ ] CHK011 Are the infrastructure and residency requirements consistent with Architecture Decision `D14` (OpenTofu in `infra/stacks/v1_foundation/`) and `D3` (`europe-west4` default residency)? [Consistency, Spec §Source Traceability & Package Scope, Plan §Project Structure]

## Acceptance Criteria & Measurability

- [ ] CHK012 Are the latency thresholds for notebook creation/redirect ($\le 1.0\text{ s}$ P95), relational/chunk cascade deletion ($\le 2.0\text{ s}$), and oversized pre-upload rejection ($\le 200\text{ ms}$) objectively measurable under the declared timing protocol? [Measurability, Spec §Success Criteria SC-001/SC-003, Quickstart §Timing Protocol]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the cross-notebook isolation success criterion ($\text{Leakage} = 0.0\%$ across `NFR-EVAL-04` and security suites) verifiable through deterministic assertions without relying on statistical tolerances? [Measurability, Spec §Success Criteria SC-002]

## Scenario & Edge-Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK014 Are concurrent boundary race conditions specified for both the final source slot ($49 / 50$ with two simultaneous uploads) and the final notebook slot ($99 / 100$ with two simultaneous creations)? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 3, Spec §Supplemental User Story 3, Data Model §Validation and Admission]
- [ ] CHK015 Is the multi-tab deletion edge case (deleting a notebook in Tab A while Tab B attempts an action) specified with exact HTTP status (`404`), user-visible message (`"Notebook no longer exists"`), and navigation recovery? [Edge Case, Spec §Supplemental User Story 1, Spec §Edge Cases FR-WM-01]
- [ ] CHK016 Is the behavior for partial batch admission ($10$ files uploaded when $45 / 50$ slots are occupied) deterministically specified regarding admission order and per-file quota warnings? [Edge Case, Spec §Supplemental User Story 3, Spec §Edge Cases FR-WM-07]
- [ ] CHK017 Does the specification define how late worker callbacks or signed-upload completions after notebook deletion are fenced so deleted notebook data is never resurrected? [Edge Case, Spec §R01 — FR-WM-01, Data Model §Notebook Deletion]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
